text: Australia’s Cyclone Recovery Program (CRP) in Fiji is a post-disaster reconstruction initiative funded by the Australian Government through the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT). It focuses on rebuilding key education infrastructure to climate-resilient standards following the devastation of Tropical Cyclone Yasa in December 2020. The program aims to deliver quality, inclusive, and climate-resilient school facilities under the Fiji–Australia Vuvale Partnership framework.
